meta_reflection: Thirteen consecutive empty-experiment milestones is a reliable indicator of a structural pipeline failure, not a workload-pacing issue. Operational improvements (DualGPURunner, batch sizing, model caching) cannot improve a milestone that runs no experiments. The highest-leverage investment is not tuning execution efficiency but fixing the activation path so tasks actually launch. Each empty milestone that closes without a pre-staged roadmap perpetuates the gap at zero cost-to-diagnose and maximum cost-to-milestone-throughput.
